candidates.text: 拓扑管理器为组件提供了一个称为 **建议提供者（Hint Provider）** 的接口，以发送和接收拓扑信息。
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text: 拓扑管理器从**建议提供者**接收拓扑信息，作为表示可用的 NUMA 节点和首选分配指示的位掩码。
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text: 拓扑管理器策略对所提供的建议执行一组操作，并根据策略对提示进行约减以得到最优解。
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text: 越来越多的系统利用 CPU 和硬件加速器的组合来支持要求低延迟的任务和高吞吐量的并行计算。
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text:
An increasing number of systems leverage a combination of CPUs and hardware accelerators to
support latency-critical execution and high-throughput parallel computation.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text:
These include
workloads in fields such as telecommunications, scientific computing, machine learning, financial
services and data analytics.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text: Such hybrid systems comprise a high performance environment.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text:
In order to extract the best performance, optimizations related to CPU isolation, memory and
device locality are required.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text:
However, in Kubernetes, these optimizations are handled by a
disjoint set of components.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text:
_Topology Manager_ is a kubelet component that aims to coordinate the set of components that are
responsible for these optimizations.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text:
The Topology Manager has a set of node level policies which are
explained below.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text:
The Topology Manager receives topology information from the *Hint Providers* as a bitmask denoting
NUMA Nodes available and a preferred allocation indication.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text:
The Topology Manager policies perform
a set of operations on the hints provided and converge on the hint determined by the policy to
give the optimal result.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text:
If an undesirable hint is stored, the preferred field for the hint will be
set to false.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text: In the current policies preferred is the narrowest preferred mask.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text: The selected hint is stored as part of the Topology Manager.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text:
Depending on the policy configured,
the pod can be accepted or rejected from the node based on the selected hint.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text:
The hint is then stored in the Topology Manager for use by the *Hint Providers* when making the
resource allocation decisions.
candidates.title: topology-manager

candidates.text: 由于 Kubernetes 的安全性并不是“一刀切”的，因此针对每一类检查清单项目都应该做价值评估。

candidates.text:

candidates.text:
如果使用云服务供应商托管的 Kubernetes，在没有明确需要的情况下，

candidates.text:
In fact,
`system:masters` should only be used as a break-glass mechanism, as opposed to
an admin user.

candidates.text:
This checklist aims at providing a basic list of guidance with links to more
comprehensive documentation on each topic.
candidates.title: security-checklist

candidates.text:
It does not claim to be exhaustive
and is meant to evolve.
candidates.title: security-checklist

candidates.text:
Checklists are **not** sufficient for attaining a good security posture on their
own.
candidates.title: security-checklist

candidates.text:
A good security posture requires constant attention and improvement, but a
checklist can be the first step on the never-ending journey towards security
preparedness.
candidates.title: security-checklist

candidates.text:
Some of the recommendations in this checklist may be too
restrictive or too lax for your specific security needs.
candidates.title: security-checklist

candidates.text:
Since Kubernetes
security is not "one size fits all", each category of checklist items should be
evaluated on its merits.
candidates.title: security-checklist

candidates.text:
If a cloud provider is used for hosting Kubernetes, the access from pods to the cloud
metadata API `169.254.169.254` should also be restricted or blocked if not needed

candidates.text:
作为[云驱动提取工作](/blog/2019/04/17/the-future-of-cloud-providers-in-kubernetes/)
的一部分，所有特定于云的控制器都必须移出 `kube-controller-manager`。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
所有在 `kube-controller-manager` 中运行云控制器的现有集群必须迁移到特定于云厂商的
`cloud-controller-manager` 中运行这些控制器。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
领导者迁移（Leader Migration）提供了一种机制，使得 HA 集群可以通过这两个组件之间共享资源锁，
在升级多副本的控制平面时，安全地将“特定于云”的控制器从 `kube-controller-manager` 迁移到
`cloud-controller-manager`。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
对于单节点控制平面，或者在升级过程中可以容忍控制器管理器不可用的情况，则不需要领导者迁移，
亦可以忽略本指南。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
领导者迁移可以通过在 `kube-controller-manager` 或 `cloud-controller-manager` 上设置
`--enable-leader-migration` 来启用。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
本指南将引导你手动将控制平面从内置的云驱动的 `kube-controller-manager` 升级为
同时运行 `kube-controller-manager` 和 `cloud-controller-manager`。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text: 如果使用某种工具来部署和管理集群，请参阅对应工具和云驱动的文档以获取迁移的具体说明。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
尽管可以在同一版本内进行迁移，但理想情况下，迁移应作为升级的一部分执行，
以便可以配置的变更可以与发布版本变化对应起来。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
例如，如果云厂商构建了一个可与 Kubernetes 1.24
配合使用的 `cloud-controller-manager`，则 N 可以为 1.23，N+1 可以为 1.24。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text: 控制平面节点应运行 `kube-controller-manager` 并启用领导者选举，这也是默认设置。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
在版本 N 中，树内云驱动必须设置 `--cloud-provider` 标志，而且 `cloud-controller-manager`
应该尚未部署。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text: 树外云驱动必须已经构建了一个实现了领导者迁移的 `cloud-controller-manager`。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
如果云驱动导入了 v0.21.0 或更高版本的 `k8s.io/cloud-provider` 和 `k8s.io/controller-manager`，
则可以进行领导者迁移。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
但是，对 v0.22.0 以下的版本，领导者迁移是一项 Alpha 阶段功能，需要在 `cloud-controller-manager`
中启用特性门控 `ControllerManagerLeaderMigration`。
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
As part of the [cloud provider extraction effort](/blog/2019/04/17/the-future-of-cloud-providers-in-kubernetes/),
all cloud specific controllers must be moved out of the `kube-controller-manager`.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
All existing clusters that run cloud controllers in the `kube-controller-manager`
must migrate to instead run the controllers in a cloud provider specific
`cloud-controller-manager`.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
For a single-node control plane, or if
unavailability of controller managers can be tolerated during the upgrade, Leader
Migration is not needed and this guide can be ignored.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
Leader Migration can be enabled by setting `--enable-leader-migration` on
`kube-controller-manager` or `cloud-controller-manager`.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
Leader Migration only
applies during the upgrade and can be safely disabled or left enabled after the
upgrade is complete.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
This guide walks you through the manual process of upgrading the control plane from
`kube-controller-manager` with built-in cloud provider to running both
`kube-controller-manager` and `cloud-controller-manager`.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
If you use a tool to deploy
and manage the cluster, please refer to the documentation of the tool and the cloud
provider for specific instructions of the migration.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
It is assumed that the control plane is running Kubernetes version N and to be
upgraded to version N + 1.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
Although it is possible to migrate within the same
version, ideally the migration should be performed as part of an upgrade so that
changes of configuration can be aligned to each release.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
The exact versions of N and
N + 1 depend on each cloud provider.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
For example, if a cloud provider builds a
`cloud-controller-manager` to work with Kubernetes 1.24, then N can be 1.23 and N + 1
can be 1.24.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
The control plane nodes should run `kube-controller-manager` with Leader Election
enabled, which is the default.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
As of version N, an in-tree cloud provider must be set
with `--cloud-provider` flag and `cloud-controller-manager` should not yet be
deployed.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration

candidates.text:
The out-of-tree cloud provider must have built a `cloud-controller-manager` with
Leader Migration implementation.
candidates.title: controller-manager-leader-migration
